metadata.indication: Metastatic basal-cell carcinoma. / Locally advanced basal-cell carcinoma not suitable for surgery or radiotherapy.

indications.description: Locally advanced basal-cell carcinoma not suitable for surgery or radiotherapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Vismodegib 150 mg once daily continuously; use a 28-day assessment-cycle convention. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
